newsitem.title: USA: Clinton aide to meet Chinese president in Beijing.
newsitem.headline: Clinton aide to meet Chinese president in Beijing.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton's national security adviser Sandy Berger will meet Chinese President Jiang Zemin in Beijing next week to discuss preparations for an October summit, the White House said on Wednesday.
Spokeswoman Anne Luzzatto said Berger would depart Saturday for Beijing and would have talks with Jiang and other Chinese leaders before returning to Washington next Wednesday.
She said the main goal of the visit was to discuss preparations for Jiang's state visit to the United States planned for late October in Washington.
"He'll meet with Jiang and other Chinese leaders to continue the strategic dialogue that we began last year which covers a broad range of issues that we have with the Chinese," she said.
The Clinton administration has said in recent days that China's negotiating offers in its efforts to join the World Trade Organisation have not been enough to meet the conditions for WTO membership.
A reciprocal visit to China by Clinton is expected during his second four-year term.
